caption:
Self-optimization feels like progress. But for an overthinker's brain, it's just a respectable version of the same loop — analyze, plan, track, repeat. The exit isn't a better system. It's recognizing what's already enough.

The Enough List is from the free 7-Day Overthinking Detox — DM "DETOX" to get it.

Save this for the next productivity spiral. Send it to someone whose self-improvement has become self-punishment.
